final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level", "debug"], ["5", "true"]) == ["fast", "5", "true"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var other_keys: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy values[i]
    else
      if k == "level"
        level = copy values[i]
      else
        var seen = False
        for ok in other_keys
          if ok == k
            seen = True
        if seen == False
          other_keys.append(copy k)
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode)
  res.append(level)
  for ok in other_keys
    var v = ""
    for i in range(0, keys.len())
      if keys[i] == ok
        v = copy values[i]
    res.append(v)
  res
